result.title: Video-as-Experience: Learning Computer Use via Audio-Visual Understanding
result.summary: Multimodal large language models (LLMs) have enabled capable computer-use agents that perceive graphical user interfaces, reason over instructions, and execute actions. However, existing approaches to learning from video demonstrations typically convert videos into screenshot-based action trajectories, rather than directly leveraging their rich audio-visual information. We introduce VEX (Video as EXperience), a framework that uses audio-visual understanding to unify learning from external demonstrations and reflecting on an agent's own behavior. Following a watch-act-rewatch paradigm, the agent extracts procedural guidance from tutorial videos containing visual demonstrations and spoken explanations, executes tasks, and verifies its progress by rewatching its execution as video. We instantiate VEX with video-SALMONN-VEX, a 9B-scale audio-visual computer-use agent built on the video-SALMONN 2 architecture with a Qwen3.5-9B backbone. We further introduce Action-Grounded Guide Optimization (AGGO), a reinforcement learning method that optimizes video-derived guidance for downstream action prediction, and augment AgentNet, OSWorld, and CUA-Gym with over 24K real-world tutorial videos. Experiments on OSWorld and a complementary subset of CUA-Gym demonstrate consistent improvements, with video-SALMONN-VEX achieving a 22% relative increase in task success over its Qwen3.5 backbone on OSWorld. Moreover, its generated guidance improves Gemini-3.5-flash by 10% relatively on OSWorld. These results highlight the potential of audio-visual understanding as a unified interface for procedural learning and self-verification in computer-use agents.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 VEX 框架，用视听理解把含画面演示与语音讲解的教程视频转成过程性指导，让 computer-use agent 按「看—做—重看」执行任务，并用重看自身执行视频的方式核查进度；同时提出 AGGO 强化学习，使视频得到的指导更利于下游动作预测，并在 OSWorld 等基准上验证增益。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把重看视频作为执行中自我核查的环节，可供核查 LVR 中何时重新获取视觉证据与停止决策的问题；用 RL 训练中间指导以服务动作预测，也与轨迹监督和贡献分配有相通之处，但该指导是显式文本而非 latent 状态，联系较为间接。
